tools.name: ConvertC2SIMContent
tools.description: Convert C2SIM content (e.g. between BML/IBML formats) to STP's native object-set representation. The conversion happens entirely inside the engine's own SDK layer and never reaches the C2SIM bridge agent. Returns the converted objects as the multiline string ObjectSet.ToMultilineString() produces: "object_set([" followed by one STP object per line and a closing "])". Three things are worth knowing before you rely on the result. SYMBOLS ONLY: units and tactical graphics are extracted, but tasks are not created. This is a long-standing, deliberate limitation - STP tasks carry more detail than C2SIM captures, and the missing information cannot be filled in from an Order document. NOT IDEMPOTENT: the conversion mints a task org to hold the converted symbols (one per affiliation present, named "Friendly TO" and "Hostile TO") with a freshly generated identifier on every call, so converting the same document twice yields two different task orgs. NO PARENT COA: converted symbols are parented to that minted task org, but a purely local conversion mints no course of action, so nothing carries a parent COA - a caller that needs COA-parented objects, to load them into a scenario say, must mint the COAs and parent the objects itself. Input must be well-formed XML: a well-formed document with nothing convertible yields an empty "object_set([])" shell, but malformed content fails the call rather than returning an empty result.

options.description: Accepted for wire compatibility with existing clients (the public .NET SDK sends this field) and then IGNORED. That is deliberate, and it differs from the sibling C2SIM methods on purpose: those carry an enumerated key set and reject an unknown key rather than ignoring it (STP-687), whereas this method has no key set to enumerate. Those keys configure the C2SIM bridge agent, and this conversion is purely local to the engine's SDK layer and never reaches that agent. Nothing passed here can change the result.

options.description: Generation options. Applied to THIS CALL ONLY - options no longer persist into the engine's shared configuration, so nothing one caller passes affects any later call or any other session (STP-687). The key set is definite and enumerated below, NOT implementation-defined. An unknown or misspelled key fails the call with success = false and nothing applied, rather than being silently ignored. Key names are compared CASE-INSENSITIVELY, so the camelCase spellings used by the JS SDK's StpC2SIMOptions (for example restUrl for resturl) are equivalent to the canonical names listed here. Three properties of the engine's configuration are deliberately NOT settable over the wire because they are not operator-settable either - stphost and stpport drive the engine's own long-lived connection, and backgroundmode is set by the host process.

runafterinitialize.description: Switch the C2SIM server to Running immediately after pushing Initialization.

fullto.description: Include the full Task Org, including entities not placed on the map. When false, only placed elements and their subordinates.

schemaversion.description: Schema version hint (1.0.0 / 1.0.1 / 1.0.2). All inputs generate 1.0.2 unified output.

addorphantgtoinitialization.description: Include tactical graphics that are not part of any task in the Initialization document.

placealltgininitialization.description: Place tactical graphics in the Initialization document instead of the Order document.

includeMapGraphicId.description: Include MapGraphicID references to tactical graphics in tasks, rather than relying on Location.

entityNameCharLimit.description: Maximum number of characters in a generated entity name; 0 for no limit.

includeDescriptionInName.description: Append the description to generated entity names - required to round-trip an ORBAT imported from C2SIM documents.

updateunitpositions.description: Use Position Report information to update units. ACCEPTED BUT INERT for a single call: it is read only by the engine's inbound report handler, which has no per-call context.

validationschema.description: Path to a schema file to validate generated XML against; empty for no validation.

startdate.description: Mission start date. ACCEPTED BUT INERT: nothing in the C2SIM bridge reads it.

phaseduration.description: Duration of each STP phase, in minutes.

unknownfstname.description: Unknown forces name. ACCEPTED BUT INERT: nothing in the C2SIM bridge reads it.

unknownfstuuid.description: Unknown forces unique id. ACCEPTED BUT INERT: nothing in the C2SIM bridge reads it.

options.description: Push options. Applied to THIS CALL ONLY - options no longer persist into the engine's shared configuration, so nothing one caller passes affects any later call or any other session (STP-687). The key set is definite and enumerated below, NOT implementation-defined. An unknown or misspelled key fails the call with success = false and nothing applied, rather than being silently ignored. Key names are compared CASE-INSENSITIVELY, so the camelCase spellings used by the JS SDK's StpC2SIMOptions (for example restUrl for resturl) are equivalent to the canonical names listed here. Three properties of the engine's configuration are deliberately NOT settable over the wire because they are not operator-settable either - stphost and stpport drive the engine's own long-lived connection, and backgroundmode is set by the host process.

tools.name: SyncScenarioSessionFromObjectSet
tools.description: Load a scenario from an in-memory object set and update the session state with detected differences. Object-set equivalent of SyncScenarioSession.

objects.description: STP objects making up the scenario to sync against.

tools.name: ChangeTimeOut
tools.description: Set the wait and segmentation timeouts together, in seconds. This is the only public control over how long STP waits before deciding a sketch is finished, so it is required whenever a user draws a multi-stroke 2525/APP6 symbol: use 0.0 for ordinary single-stroke point, line and area work, and around 2.5 while a full symbol is being drawn. Fire and forget.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. 0.0 restores single-stroke behaviour.

tools.name: ResetSegmentationTimeout
tools.description: Restore the segmentation timeout to its configured default, undoing an earlier ChangeTimeOut. Fire and forget.

tools.name: SetSpeechListening
tools.description: Turn speech capture on or off for this client. Fire and forget; STP reports the resulting state through the AudioCapture event.

listen.description: True to start listening, false to stop.

tools.name: RecognizeNow
tools.description: Recognize whatever has been collected so far instead of waiting for the segmentation timeout to expire. Fire and forget.

tools.name: SendListen
tools.description: Ask STP to start or stop listening. Fire and forget. NB the .NET SDK serialises `mode` with default settings, so it arrives as the ORDINAL of the enum rather than its name; the engine accepts either spelling.

mode.description: Listening mode: once (0) listens until the first inactivity, on (1) listens until told to stop, off (2) stops.

time.description: Timestamp of the request. Defaults to now.

tools.name: SendAudioCaptureState
tools.description: Report this client's own audio capture state to STP so other components can reflect it in their user interface. Fire and forget.

isListening.description: True while this client is capturing audio.

tools.name: AdvertiseViewport
tools.description: Tell STP which geographic area this client is currently showing, so recognition can be biased towards what the user can actually see. Fire and forget.

topLeft.description: North-west corner of the visible map.

botRight.description: South-east corner of the visible map.

tools.name: SetAutoTasking
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic tasking, in which STP infers tasks from symbols without an explicit spoken task. Fire and forget.

tools.name: ResetRole
tools.description: Clear the role previously set with SetRole, returning this client to the default role. Fire and forget.

tools.name: UndoLastOp
tools.description: Undo the last operation applied to an object. STP replays the effect as ordinary events carrying isUndo = true, so a client that already handles the Added/Modified/Deleted events needs no extra handling. Fire and forget.

poid.description: Unique id of the object whose last operation is to be undone.

tools.name: ResetStpScenario
tools.description: Discard the current scenario contents on the server, leaving the scenario itself in place. Returns no value.

tools.name: GetActiveScenarioDescription
tools.description: Return the metadata of the scenario currently loaded - its name, id and session details - without fetching any of its contents.

tools.name: GetAllObjects
tools.description: Return every object in the current scenario as a flat list, symbols, tasks and task organizations alike. Prefer GetScenarioContent or GetScenarioObjectSet when the structured form is wanted.

tools.name: GetDeletedObjects
tools.description: Return the objects deleted from the current scenario. A deleted object is TOMBSTONED rather than removed, so it is still reachable here and its poid can be reused by a later add.

tools.name: GetPoidObject
tools.description: Return a single object by its unique id. Returns null when no object carries that poid.

poid.description: Unique id of the object to fetch.

tools.name: GetScenarioTaskOrgList
tools.description: Return the task organizations (ORBATs) defined in the current scenario, as summaries rather than full contents.

tools.name: GetTaskOrgObjects
tools.description: Return the objects making up a task organization as a plain array. This is a SYNONYM of GetTaskOrgObjectSet - both reach the same engine call and return the same array; the two spellings exist because the .NET SDK grew both.
